punchline: Wegener saw the continents fit like a puzzle and was rejected because he could not say what moved them.
thirty_sec: Alfred Wegener saw that Africa and South America fit together, and that fossils and rock belts matched across the ocean. Geologists rejected his idea of drifting continents because he had no convincing force to move them. Decades later, ocean-floor measurements and plate tectonics confirmed the basic direction of what he had observed.
